title: Matching Upper and Lower Bounds for Higher-Order Nonconvex Finite-Sum Optimization
summary: We establish tight randomized higher-order oracle complexity for finding first-order stationary points of nonconvex finite sums. Let $n$ be the number of components, $Δ>0$ the initial objective-gap bound, $L_p>0$ an individual $p$-th derivative Lipschitz bound, and $ε>0$ the target gradient norm.
